tasks.title: Implement WorkflowRun failed-work retry
tasks.description: Update WorkflowRun and StageRun retry behavior so retry reopens the latest failed current-stage work without clearing earlier valid work. Cover failed task retry and failed check retry in focused domain tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Retry of a failed task resets that task and same-stage downstream work while preserving earlier completed tasks
Retry of a failed check preserves completed tasks and earlier passed checks while resetting the failed check and downstream checks or derived work
Retry clears current failure and approval state without changing the current stage
Domain tests cover failed task retry and failed check retry
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Produces the authoritative retry state transition consumed by API and regression tasks.

tasks.title: Implement WorkflowRun current-stage rerun
tasks.description: Update WorkflowRun and StageRun rerun behavior so rerun resets the current stage from the first work item while preserving earlier passed stages. Cover Plan-stage rerun with existing artifact files in focused domain tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Rerun Stage resets all task, check, failure, approval, and retry-derived state in the current stage from the first work item
Rerun Stage does not change the current stage or reset earlier passed stages
Plan rerun makes the first Plan work pending even when prior Plan artifact files exist
Domain tests cover rerun current stage from first work
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: May reuse reset helpers introduced for retry in T-001.

tasks.title: Make retry API use WorkflowRun failed work
tasks.description: Update the workflow application and retry endpoint so `POST /api/issues/:number/retry` is available when the latest WorkflowRun has retryable failed work in the current stage. Remove checkpoint or `tasks.json` existence as the primary retry gate while preserving distinct external-resource errors.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/issues/:number/retry` accepts a failed current-stage WorkflowRun even when `tasks.json` has not been generated
Retry availability is rejected with a distinct error when there is no failed WorkflowRun
Retry availability is rejected with a distinct error when there is no retryable failed work in the current stage
Retry availability is rejected with distinct errors for missing required project, worktree, or change artifacts
Retry success queues pipeline recovery without changing stage or clearing the whole stage attempt
API or service tests cover retry before `tasks.json` exists and the major retry rejection reasons
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes T-001 domain retry semantics and exposes them through HTTP.

tasks.title: Make rerun API restart current stage work
tasks.description: Update the rerun endpoint and Plan runner so `POST /api/issues/:number/rerun` applies true current-stage rerun semantics instead of retry fallback behavior. Ensure Plan execution honors pending WorkflowRun work during rerun and does not mark artifacts complete solely because old files exist.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/issues/:number/rerun` keeps the current stage unchanged and preserves earlier passed stages
Rerun clears current-stage checkpoint, failure, approval, blocked reason, and retry count before queueing recovery
Rerun resumes execution from the first current-stage work item rather than first incomplete work
Plan rerun executes `proposal`, `specs`, `design`, `tasks`, and `self-review` according to WorkflowRun pending work even when prior artifact files already exist
Normal interruption resume can still use completed checkpoint or WorkflowRun state to avoid unnecessary Plan artifact regeneration
Tests cover rerun restarting Plan from the first Plan work with existing `proposal.md`, `specs/`, and `design.md` files
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes T-002 rerun semantics and T-003 recovery API error structure.

tasks.title: Show retry errors in Issue detail
tasks.description: Update Issue detail recovery actions so retry mutation errors are displayed through the same action error area as rerun, start, close, and reopen failures. Add UI coverage proving retry API errors are visible after a failed retry click.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail action error area displays retry mutation errors returned by the API
Retry, Rerun Stage, Start, Close, and Reopen action errors use the same visible error display pattern on Issue detail
The user can still see and choose other available recovery actions after a retry error appears
Web UI tests or component coverage verify retry API errors are visible to the user
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the visible API errors from T-003 and rerun behavior from T-004.

tasks.title: Align CLI recovery vocabulary
tasks.description: Update CLI-facing workflow recovery messages so they use retry, rerun, and rewind terminology consistently. Remove workflow recovery copy that says the pipeline will restart, while leaving unrelated server restart commands intact.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI recovery guidance uses retry, rerun, and rewind terminology for workflow recovery
Approval rejection output no longer says the pipeline will restart
Workflow recovery copy does not use restart except for unrelated server restart commands or the removed restart endpoint message
CLI tests or targeted assertions cover the changed recovery message
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes API recovery terminology from T-003 and T-004.

tasks.title: Add #215 recovery regression coverage
tasks.description: Add end-to-end or integration-style regression coverage for the #215 failure shape: Plan fails while generating `tasks.json`, retry retries the failed Plan artifact work, and rerun restarts Plan from the first Plan work. Use existing test infrastructure and keep the scenario deterministic without requiring external agent calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test simulates Plan failure while generating `tasks.json` before the file exists
Regression test verifies Retry retries the failed Plan work instead of returning a checkpoint-required error
Regression test verifies Rerun Stage restarts Plan from the first Plan work instead of continuing at `tasks` or `self-review`
Regression test verifies retry and rerun preserve the stage and do not rerun earlier passed stages
Relevant package tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Final verification task; depends on all behavior and user-surface changes being present.
